title: Fueling Life on Earth: Chemosynthesis versus Photosynthesis — NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration, Educator Guide and Teacher Key (grades 9-12 chemistry)

NOAA's Education and Outreach FAQ (https://www.noaa.gov/office-education/outreach-communication/faq) states: 'Nearly all of NOAA content, including images, videos, data products, educational materials, and more, is in the public domain and can be used without express permission', and requires credit to NOAA without claiming or endorsing; edits and generative-AI outputs must not be presented as official NOAA material. transcription: Educator guide and teacher key (printed pages 1-7) of a 11-page PDF (HTTP 200, 1,576,353 bytes), read from the PDF text layer with pdftotext -enc UTF-8; pages 8-10 (print templates for the colour-key and molecule cut-out cards) and page 11 (the links-and-resources list) were not transcribed. Site furniture removed: the running header 'Fueling Life on Earth: Chemosynthesis versus Photosynthesis', the 'EDUCATOR | www.oceanexplorer.noaa.gov' footer, the printed page numbers, the page-1 photo caption with the WHOI credit, the 'Educator Guide cont.' / 'Teacher Key: Fueling Life on Earth cont.' continuation labels, and the two 'FOR MORE INFORMATION' link labels. Section labels that print as headings (Overview, Educator Guide, Teacher Key: Fueling Life on Earth) are marked with '##'. The reaction arrows print as arrow glyphs whose text-layer code point is unassigned (the bytes are EF 83 A8, a private-area mapping with no ToUnicode entry); they are transcribed as '→', and the two link-list bullets (EF 80 B4) as '•'. The text layer splits some kerned words after their first capital and inserts a control character there ('O\x07 ccurs', '\x07U\t se'); those are rejoined to the words the page prints ('Occurs', 'Use') and no other wording was touched. Formulas print with subscripts and are transcribed as plain digits. Original typos and oddities are kept as printed: 'Hydrogen Suifide', 'Two 50-minute class period', 'lefthand side', 'Student Worksheet: Fueling All Life on Earth', 'DRIVING QUESTION How does…' (label and text run together on the page), the double spacing inside 'working   to figure out', and the question mark ending the Data Table instruction. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: Stage 6 chemistry (balance-the-equation): prints two complete balanced equations twice — '6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2' (photosynthesis) and 'CO2 + 4H2S + O2 → CH2O + 4S + 3H2O' (chemosynthesis) — with the compound names under each species, the balancing rule in words ('the law of conservation of matter states that matter cannot be created or destroyed. So, all the reactant components on the left must be used to create the products on the right…'), the coefficient explanation ('6CO2 means they need six copies of the CO2 molecule'), the reactant/product definitions, and the cube inventory (7 Carbon, 20 Hydrogen, 22 Oxygen, 4 Sulfur) which is exactly the atom total of both equations, so a checker can verify atom conservation without a model. 'Suifide' and the worksheet-name typo are deliberate fidelity traps.
